title: Bump opum-lore and opum-quest federated pins to v0.13.0 (LCLI-469 paired release)
description: LCLI-469 handshake message 2 (from lore-cli): lore 0.13.0 and quest 0.13.0 are both on npm latest (all packages), and both GitHub Release tags are cut. Paired move per the Opum constitution Article 3 clause 4 and the LCLI-469 runbook: opum-lore and opum-quest move to the same version in one change. MOVED case for BOTH: lore-cli v0.13.0 skills tree is 437ae5a97cce348f0e5bda24ccedb1e1afc29960 where v0.12.0 was ce580cd17d1da6a61ddb53f649398719b9262f96, and quest-cli v0.13.0 skills tree is e05b68c27490ea1037fc92700576e35a2ec37fb9 where v0.12.0 was e007a327642427d6ab38534e89403c8a84ac46ef, so both baselines must move in the same change. Values re-resolved independently via the GitHub git-database API (the exact chain check-federated-content.mjs walks): lore tag ref v0.13.0 -> tag object 7b6e2f91e716e6d26622d1f2e96a1876686dc4cd -> commit 838ba150fbeeb608266fa801dd533a05ad34a3b6 -> root tree 26a4c49cc3ed62d14534035fd924ae956269372b -> skills 437ae5a9; quest tag ref v0.13.0 -> tag object f24ad2d464dcc95ed32177fdd7d764da475dfc2c -> commit 5996e24a8bff3f29fdbbaec32c1892adfdd3400e -> root tree dfb260fd4d6aefecb5c40f0c97700f40868b569d -> skills e05b68c2. Both plugin.json at the tag self-declare version 0.13.0. Promotion of dev to main is a separate orchestrator decision and is not part of this task.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Opum-lore and opum-quest refs in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json both move from v0.12.0 to v0.13.0 in one change

scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records both re-resolved skills subtrees in the same change: opum-lore 437ae5a97cce348f0e5bda24ccedb1e1afc29960 and opum-quest e05b68c27490ea1037fc92700576e35a2ec37fb9

check-federated-pins.mjs and check-federated-content.mjs both report opum-lore and opum-quest checked and verified against the live v0.13.0 tags; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json regenerated; lore check exits 0
The paired bump lands through a PR into dev with the required checks green on the head
